The '''Resort Sector''' was a region of [[Amma]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. It was the city's main tourist area, and its coastal regions were situated on [[Bacrana Bay]]. It was bordered to the north by [[South Sector]].
